agy-NOV

The 100% Native Modular Super-Workbench for Google Antigravity 2.0.

One plugin. Thirteen toggleable superpowers built on a clean 4-layer zero-cycle systems architecture with full macOS / Windows / Linux native cross-platform compatibility (3-OS × Node 20/22 CI + 3-OS real-process hook black-box testing), featuring an opt-in read-only scheduled audit Sidecar (sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs, OFF by default) & 11th CLI command audit-once (+0 model tools), Layer 1 shared loopback-only ConversationService Connect API collaboration (powering confirmation-gated Clean Fork app_xray_fork_via_service & read-only Radar reconciliation app_radar_reconcile_conversations, +0 model tools), Antigravity Marketplace readiness alignment (10-key plugin.json with concise 148-char description + 18-asset & 4-check Marketplace doctor), Spec DAG → /run-workflow Python & /swarm plan.json native orchestration compilation (+0 model tools), PreInvocation local inbound secret hard gating (terminationBehavior: "terminate"), official 6th Lifecycle Hook PostInvocation zero-token turn receipts, 4 zero-injection-tax read-only MCP context resources (agy-nov://context/{review,mem,turbo,xray}), Antigravity 2.35 CLI statusLine stdin JSON fusion (11 composable segments incl. model & quota), Antigravity CLI 100-tool budget gating (auto-hiding app_* tools when MCP UI extensions are absent so full stays strictly at 47 tools), live roots/list dynamic workspace tracking, cross-platform plugin-root relative hooks (node dist/hook.cjs --event <Event>), 4+1 domain IA & 4-tier Settings Hub (with S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor), Ops 3.0, Mem 3.0, One-Click Clean Fork, 6 official on-demand Skills & 2 read-only specialist subagents, native MCP Apps file viewer, Remote 2.5, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5, 6 official Hooks, 8-language full-component UI (755 core keys × 8 locales + full Spec export localization, 1,390.2 KB), minified backend bundles & 11-command CLI (18-asset doctor). Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, strictly 47 canonical model tools with zero token tax when off.

It has no affiliation with, sponsorship from, or endorsement by Google LLC. --- ## 30-Second Read-Only First Try Evaluate `agy-NOV` on your current workspace with **zero file edits, zero config writes, and zero network traffic**: ```bash # 1. Scan your repo read-only and preview a safe .agy-nov.json team preset scaffold (zero disk writes) # After `agy plugin install` (zero global install needed): node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-nov/dist/cli.cjs recommend --workspace=. --export-preset # Or if you linked `agy-nov` globally (`npm link` inside the plugin directory) or inside a cloned repo: agy-nov recommend --export-preset ``` 2. Paste this **100% read-only first prompt** into Antigravity 2.0 once installed (also available inside the **L0 Workflow Hub** and the collapsible **30-Second Zero-Risk First Try** guide in **Settings Hub**): > *"Open agy-NOV Context X-Ray in read-only mode to inspect my estimated offline USD spend, 5-hour burn-rate window, and prefix cache hit rate — then open Two-Stage Diff Review with `-w` whitespace-ignored and line risk hints without modifying any files."* --- ## Why agy-NOV? Installing separate MCP servers and hook scripts for code review, secret scanning, Spec-driven plan reviews & workflow compilation, Stop-hook verification, Git worktrees, local data/document/OpenAPI debugging, Swarm & offline USD telemetry, confidence-governed progressive memory, token-saving log compression, session tracking, and static security/dedup/budget audits quickly turns a clean Antigravity workspace into a noisy stack of background daemons pushing against Antigravity's **100-tool MCP hard limit**. | Dimension | ❌ Plugin Sprawl (12–13 Separate Tools) | ✅ agy-NOV Super-Workbench | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Resident Processes** | 12–13 background Node/Python servers competing for RAM and startup time | **1 resident MCP server** (`dist/server.cjs`, minified `1,583.5 KB`) serving all enabled capabilities with live `roots/list` workspace tracking, **4 zero-injection-tax `agy-nov://context/*` resources**, & **1 opt-in OFF-by-default read-only Audit Sidecar** (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, zero idle daemon) | | **Per-Turn Token & Tool Cap** | 70+ static tool schemas plus bulky resident `rules/AGENTS.md` files crowding the 100-tool limit | **Dynamic `tools/list`** (strictly **47** canonical model tools max across `v0.4`→`v1.2.0`, `0` token & tool-slot tax when off) + **CLI 47-tool ceiling gate** (auto-hiding `app_*`/`nov_app_*` on headless CLI clients without MCP UI extensions) + **SettingsHub S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor** + **6 on-demand Skills & 2 read-only subagents** with zero default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat | | **Lifecycle Hook Storm** | Multiple forked hook scripts racing on every `SessionStart` / `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse` / `PreInvocation` / `PostInvocation` / `Stop` | **1 unified 6-hook dispatcher** (`dist/hook.cjs`, minified `211.9 KB`) invoked via cross-platform plugin-root relative `node dist/hook.cjs --event `, with O(1) read-only short-circuiting, `PreInvocation` local inbound secret hard gating (`terminationBehavior: "terminate"`), `PostInvocation` zero-token turn receipts, official `Stop` `decision: "continue"`, and explicit `PreToolUse` `{ decision: "allow" }` | | **Upgrade Durability & OS Support** | Binary `app.asar` patches, POSIX-only shell assumptions, and DOM hooks break after updates or on Windows/Linux | **100% official native protocols** — Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, clean **4-layer zero-cycle architecture** ([`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)) with shared loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API, official MCP Apps `file` viewer (with `antigravity-file://` host `resources/read`), Marketplace-ready 10-key manifest, and full **macOS / Windows / Linux** native compatibility (3-OS × Node 20/22 CI + 3-OS real-process hook black-box testing) | | **Workflow, Governance & UX** | Disconnected panels, stale/unverified memories, unvetted rules/hooks, cramped sidebars, English-only screens | **Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar (`audit-once`)**, **Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` & `/swarm` Compiler**, **11-segment stdin-fused CLI `statusLine`**, **Ops 3.0** static security & dedup preview, **Mem 3.0** confidence/TTL hygiene, **One-Click Clean Fork** (+ `ConversationService` create), **Radar live host reconciliation**, **4+1 Domain IA** (`Hub` + 4 domains, adaptive `< 720px` / `>= 720px` nav with `global` degradation, `⌘K`), **4-tier Settings Hub**, **8-language full-component UI (24 components)**, **5 presets**, `.agy-nov.json` team presets, and **11 CLI commands** | ### The 100% Native Switchboard Philosophy 1. **Single Native Runtime + 4-Layer Architecture + Opt-In Sidecar & Zero-Bloat Playbooks:** 1 MCP server (`dist/server.cjs`, `1,583.5 KB`, exposing **4 zero-injection-tax `agy-nov://context/*` read-only resources**) + 1 unified **6-hook** lifecycle dispatcher (`dist/hook.cjs`, `211.9 KB`, covering `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreInvocation`, `PostInvocation`, and `Stop` via plugin-root relative `node dist/hook.cjs --event `) + 1 self-contained 8-language dark/light UI (`dist/ui/app.html`, `~1.36 MiB` — measured **`1,390.2 KB`**, far below the 10 MiB resource cap, shipping **755 core dictionary keys × 8 locales** plus full key-symmetric localization for Spec workflow export across all **24 UI components**) + 1 modular **11-command CLI** (`dist/cli.cjs`, `190.0 KB`, including `audit-once` read-only health sweep, Antigravity 2.35 stdin JSON-fused 11-segment `statusline`, read-only `compile-spec`, preview-then-confirm `recommend --export-preset`, zero-split-brain `resolveNovDataDir()`, and Marketplace-ready `doctor` verifying all **18** core plugin assets + **4** Marketplace Readiness Checks) + 1 opt-in OFF-by-default read-only Audit Sidecar ([`sidecars/README.md`](./sidecars/README.md)) + **6 official on-demand Skills** (`agy-nov` + `/nov-spec`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff`, `/nov-workflow`) + **2 official read-only specialist subagents** (`agents/nov-blind-reviewer.md`, `agents/nov-security-auditor.md`), keeping zero default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat across **macOS, Windows, and Linux**. 2. **Zero Token & Tool-Slot Tax When Off (+ CLI 47-Tool Ceiling Gate):** Every module wraps its model tools in `RegisteredTool.enable()` / `.disable()` and pushes delta `tools/list_changed` notifications live. All **47 canonical model tool names** stay strictly unchanged from `v0.4` through `v1.2.0` (+0 tool-slot inflation); all Hub, Settings Hub (incl. S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor), Spec workflow compilation (`app_spec_compile_workflow`), Context Pack, Turn Rewind, Clean Fork (`app_xray_build_clean_fork_pack` & confirmation-gated `app_xray_fork_via_service`), Radar live host reconciliation (`app_radar_reconcile_conversations`), `.worktreeinclude` preview (`app_worktree_preview_include`), PR evidence summary (`app_verify_pr_summary`), Mem 3.0 hygiene summary & batch cleanup (`app_mem_get_hygiene_summary`, `app_mem_batch_hygiene`), and native `file` viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`) controls run strictly as App-only tools (`visibility: ['app']`) with zero model-context overhead — and when a headless Antigravity CLI client connects without `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]`, the server hides every `app_*` / `nov_app_*` tool automatically so even `full` exposes strictly 47 tools. 3. **Production-Grade Loop & 12 Local Offline Modules First:** Organized into **L0 Workflow Hub** (6-node pipeline bar + alert cards + One-Click Clean Fork + `Cmd/Ctrl+K` quick jump) and 4 clear domains — **Core Essentials** (`core`: Two-Stage `review`, **Guard 2.5**, `xray` 2.0 + Clean Fork), **Engineering Pipeline** (`pipeline`: **Spec 2.0 + Workflow Compiler**, `worktree` with read-only `.worktreeinclude`, `verify` with Worktree targeting & PR summary, **Turbo 3.0**, **Mem 3.0**), **On-Demand Toolbox** (`toolbox`: `radar` 4-lane Kanban + live host reconciliation, `studio`, `canvas`, **Ops 3.0**), and **Opt-In Connectivity** (`connectivity`: **Remote 2.5**). All 12 Tier-1 modules run 100% locally with zero external network calls, zero ASAR edits, and zero CDP hooks. 4. **Zero-Port Dual-Star Feed & 1 Strictly Opt-In Remote Module (`Remote 2.5`):** Event-driven `/feed-snapshot.json` (`0600` atomic, `< 64 KiB`, O(n) redacted, enriched with `forceAskCount`, `permissionMode`, `snapshotCount`, and `latestSnapshotId`, zero mkdir/writes when `dataDir` is absent) enables zero-port read-only telemetry sharing with `agy-Sag`, while `remote` stays completely OFF by default — zero listening ports, zero background polling, zero disk writes, and zero outbound network requests until you explicitly enable it. --- ## What's New in v1.2.0 `v1.2.0` introduces an **opt-in read-only scheduled Audit Sidecar & 11th CLI command `audit-once`**, unifies lightweight cross-session host collaboration on a **Layer 1 shared loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API** (`app_xray_fork_via_service` + `app_radar_reconcile_conversations`), and aligns the plugin with **Antigravity Marketplace Readiness Certification** (`plugin.json` 148-char description + **18-asset** & **4-check** `doctor`) — preserving **+0 model tool bloat** (all **47** canonical model tools strictly unchanged from `v0.4`→`v1.2.0`, verified by **100 suites / 280 tests**; minified bundles: `dist/server.cjs` **`1,583.5 KB`**, `dist/hook.cjs` **`211.9 KB`**, `dist/cli.cjs` **`190.0 KB`**, `dist/ui/app.html` **`1,390.2 KB`** / `~1.36 MiB`): ### 1. Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar & 11th CLI Command `audit-once` (+0 Model Tools) (`server`, `cli`, `sidecars/`) - **Zero Idle Daemon by Default (`src/server/sidecar.ts`, `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, [`sidecars/README.md`](./sidecars/README.md)):** Stays completely OFF on install — zero background daemon, zero listening ports, zero directory creation, and zero disk writes until explicitly run manually, via Antigravity `/schedule`, or via OS schedulers (`cron`, `launchd`, Windows Task Scheduler). - **One-Shot Redacted Health Sweep (`audit-once` & `--once`):** Aggregates read-only Ops static security/rule scores, Mem stale-anchor and expired-unpinned counts, Verify dirty files/last status, Guard block counts, and active config posture via `agy-nov audit-once [--workspace=] [--json] [--write-report]` or `node sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs --once`. - **Guarded Optional Report Persistence (`--write-report`):** Atomically persists `<= 64 KiB` `health-sweep.json` (mode `0600`, `O_CREAT | O_EXCL` temp file + atomic rename) strictly inside an existing safe non-symlink `dataDir`, refusing unsafe symlinks and stripping host absolute paths. ### 2. Layer 1 Shared `ConversationService` Connect API Collaboration (+0 Model Tools) (`core`, `remote`, `xray`, `radar`) - **Shared Loopback-Only Client (`src/core/conversation-service.ts`):** Wraps Google Antigravity's official `product.v1.ConversationService` Connect API with strict anti-SSRF loopback validation (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]` only), silent graceful degradation when unavailable, zero CSRF token echoing, and full outbound ``/secret redaction — shared across `remote`, `xray`, and `radar`. - **Confirmation-Gated Clean Fork via Host Service (`xray` · `app_xray_fork_via_service`):** Supports dry-run Clean Fork preview and explicit `confirmCreate` direct creation of a clean new host conversation, gracefully falling back to `app.sendMessage` whenever `ConversationService` is unavailable. - **Zero-Write Live Host Board Reconciliation (`radar` · `app_radar_reconcile_conversations`):** Reconciles the local Radar board against live host `ListConversations` strictly read-only, surfacing idle ghost sessions alongside newly active host conversations with zero disk writes. ### 3. Antigravity Marketplace Readiness Certification & 18-Asset `doctor` (`plugin.json`, `cli`) - **Official 10-Key Marketplace Manifest:** `plugin.json` keeps strictly the 10 officially allowed top-level keys with `description` condensed to **148 characters** (within the 60–200 recommended window), 3 validated non-empty `suggestedPrompts`, and the 128×128 transparent-background `assets/logo.svg`. - **Expanded 18-Asset & 4-Check `doctor`:** Verifies all **18 core plugin assets** (adding `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` and `sidecars/README.md`) plus **4 Marketplace Readiness Checks** (concise 60–200 char `description`, 1–3 valid `suggestedPrompts`, relative regular `logo` asset inside plugin root, and zero `rules/AGENTS.md` always-on rule bloat).
Built on the v1.1.0 4-Layer Architecture Refactor, Spec DAG Workflow Compiler, Deterministic Security 2.0 & Antigravity 2.35 CLI statusLine Foundation - **4-Layer Modular Systems Architecture Refactor (`v1.1.0`):** Extracted zero-module-import Layer 1 core kernel (`src/core/{fs-safe,process-safe,brain-paths,sanitize,module-contract}.ts`), decomposed 8 oversized monoliths (`ops/core.ts`, `verify/core.ts`, `studio/core.ts`, `turbo/core.ts`, `spec/core.ts`, `worktree/core.ts`, `cli.ts`, `SpecPanel.tsx`) with zero circular dependencies, published [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md), and enforced layer rules via `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts`. - **Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` & `/swarm` Native Orchestration Compiler (`v1.1.0`):** Kahn topological wave compiler (`src/modules/spec/compiler.ts`) generating `/run-workflow` Python orchestration (`phase`/`parallel`/`agent`/`log` chaining `nov-blind-reviewer`, `nov-security-auditor`, and `Verify Gate`) and `/swarm` `plan.json` blueprints with cycle blocking, linear redaction, App-only `app_spec_compile_workflow` 8-language UI modal, read-only CLI `compile-spec`, and 6th official Skill `/nov-workflow`. - **Deterministic Security & Zero-Injection Context 2.0 (`v1.1.0`):** `PreInvocation` local inbound high-confidence secret hard gate (`terminationBehavior: "terminate"`, zero secret echo, Guard `blockInboundPromptSecrets`), official 6th Lifecycle Hook `PostInvocation` (O(1) short-circuit, zero-token `systemMessage: ""` + `metadata.user_markdown` turn receipts), and 4 zero-injection-tax read-only MCP context resources (`agy-nov://context/{review,mem,turbo,xray}`, `<= 32 KiB`, linear redacted, zero writes). - **Antigravity 2.35 CLI `statusLine` stdin JSON Fusion (`v1.1.0`):** Async bounded host stdin JSON telemetry reader (`model`, `context_window`, `cost`, `quota`, `subagents`, `workspace`, zero-delay TTY bypass, `120ms` timeout, `256 KiB` cap) expanding composable segments to **11** (adding `model` and `quota`).
Built on the v1.0.0–v1.0.2 Runtime Hardening, Cross-Platform & Governance Foundation (CLI 47-Tool Gate, roots/list Sync, 3-OS Support, Ops 3.0, Mem 3.0 & .agy-nov.json Scaffold) - **Real-Host Runtime Hardening & Full 8-Language Parity (`v1.0.2`):** Official `Stop` `decision: "continue"` (`terminationReason` safe pass-through) & `PreToolUse` `{ decision: "allow" }`; cross-platform plugin-root relative `hooks.json` (`node dist/hook.cjs --event `) + 3-OS black-box hook tests; Antigravity CLI 47-tool ceiling gate auto-hiding `app_*` tools when `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]` is absent; live `roots/list` dynamic workspace sync & split-brain-free `resolveNovDataDir()`; `NovBridge` first-frame `ontoolresult` replay, real `antigravity-file://` host `resources/read`, and `global` capability degradation; 755 core dictionary keys × 8 locales across all 24 UI components; minified backend bundles; enriched `feed-snapshot.json` telemetry; Remote 2.5 same-origin PIN lockout DoS guard & bounded SSE heartbeats; Mem 3.0 batch `verify` anchor refresh; Auto-RTK non-ASCII/parenthesis path support; native `read_file` subagent alignment. - **Full macOS / Windows / Linux Cross-Platform Support (`v1.0.1`):** `canonicalRealpathSync` Windows 8.3 short-path expansion & case-insensitive boundary checks + Linux `/home`/`/var/run`/`/var/lock` system symlink allowlist; `atomicRenameSync` NTFS retry; Windows `shell: false` Node JS entry resolution for `npm`/`npx`/`pnpm`/`yarn`/`tsc`/`eslint`/`vitest`/`jest` (CVE-2024-27980-safe); PowerShell/`cmd` destructive rules in `guard`/`remote`; `taskkill /T /F` in `verify`; headless-Linux notification skipping in `radar`; 3-OS × Node 20/22 GitHub Actions CI matrix. - **Ops 3.0 Static Security Audit, Cross-Client Dedup Preview & Tool-Slot Idle Advisor (`v1.0.0`):** Pure read-only O(n) `ops_audit_workspace` scanner (`securityFindings` + `securityScore` 0–100 across `prompt-injection`, `broad-command-allow`, `risky-hook`, `mcp-unsafe-env` with zero secret echoing and zero false positives on compliant repos), read-only `.claude/`/`.cursor/rules/`/`.codex/` SHA-256 `migrationPreview`, and SettingsHub S4 8-language **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor**. - **Mem 3.0 Confidence/TTL Hygiene & Preview-Then-Confirm `.agy-nov.json` Scaffold (`v1.0.0`):** Confidence tiers (`verified`/`normal`/`tentative`), provenance (`manual`/`spec_archive`/`auto_capture`), `ttlDays` (1–365), `Stop`-hook `tentative` + 14-day TTL auto-capture, auto-filtering expired tentative memories in `SessionStart` L1 & default `mem_recall`, `MemPanel` batch Verify / Refresh TTL (+30d) / Prune (double confirm), and read-only default `recommend --export-preset` writing atomically only with explicit `--confirm` (`--force` for overwrites, symlink refusal, zero `remote`, allowlisted verify commands).
Built on the Complete v0.7–v0.9 Native Foundation (Pipeline Loop, Clean Fork, On-Demand Playbooks & Subagents, Native file Viewer, Remote 2.5, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5 & Spec 2.0) - **End-to-End Engineering Pipeline Loop (`Spec → Worktree → Two-Stage Review → Verify → Mem` + Radar Kanban):** Safe read-only `.worktreeinclude` allowlist (`app_worktree_preview_include` + `applyInclude`, rejecting `.env*`/private keys/symlinks into `skippedSensitive` with zero auto-RCE scripts), Worktree branch switching + Two-Stage Review (Stage 1 active Spec compliance checklist + Stage 2 code quality `file:line` annotations), Worktree-targeted Verify (`worktreePath`) + redacted PR delivery summary (`app_verify_pr_summary`), and approval-first 4-lane Radar Kanban. - **One-Click Clean Fork Anti-Context-Rot (`xray` + `HubPanel`):** Read-only `app_xray_build_clean_fork_pack` (`<= 12 KB` linear-redacted Handoff + unblocked Spec `ready` tasks + Mem core code anchors) launching a clean same-project background session via official `app.sendMessage({ _meta: { "com.google.antigravity/message": { target: "new" } } })`, with graceful pill/copy fallback on `global` surfaces. - **Official On-Demand Skills & Read-Only Specialist Subagents:** Entry skill `agy-nov` + `/nov-spec`, `/nov-workflow`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff` + read-only `nov-blind-reviewer` and `nov-security-auditor` (native `read_file` only, `subagent: true, mainAgent: false`, 0 MCP tool slots, 0 default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat). - **Native MCP Apps `file` Viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`) & Remote 2.5:** Hidden-from-model native previews for `.sqlite`/`.sqlite3`/`.db`/`.csv`/`.tsv`/`.svg`/`.openapi.yaml`/`.openapi.yml` (usable even when `studio`/`canvas` stay off, with `realpath` containment, SVG XSS sanitization & `antigravity-file://` host `resources/read`) plus Remote 2.5 pure-DOM structured risk approval cards (`HIGH`/`MED`/`LOW`, affected file count, redacted command summary, latest Verify status). - **Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5, Spec 2.0 & 4+1 IA:** Opt-in Auto-RTK `PreToolUse.overwrite` proxy (`autoRtk: false` default) + offline locked dependency contracts + O(n) cross-file symbol references + redacted Context Pack; Guard 2.5 turn-grouped snapshot rewind & 3-tier `permissionMode` (`readonly-audit`/`balanced-dev`/`strict-gate` via `force_ask`); Spec 2.0 Plannotator inline review bench & Brownfield `delta` specs; L0 Workflow Hub, adaptive `< 720px` / `>= 720px` nav, `⌘K` palette, 4-tier Settings Hub, and zero-token `PreInvocation` visual receipts.

## Highlights

### 1. Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar & 11th CLI Command `audit-once` (+0 Model Tools)
- Added `src/server/sidecar.ts`, `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, and [`sidecars/README.md`](sidecars/README.md) for scheduled or on-demand read-only workspace health sweeps aggregating Ops security/rule scores, Mem anchor drift & unpinned expiration, Verify dirty/status state, and Guard deny counts.
- **Strictly OFF by default**: zero idle daemon, zero listening ports, zero directory creation, and zero disk writes unless explicitly invoked with `--write-report` against an existing non-symlink directory (`0600`, `<= 64 KiB` atomic `health-sweep.json`).
- Hardened `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` with `shell: false`, layered `lstatSync` + `realpathSync` containment verification for both `dist/` and `dist/cli.cjs`, and cross-platform host path stripping (POSIX + Windows backslash/forward-slash).

### 2. Layer 1 Loopback `ConversationService` Bridge (+0 Model Tools)
- Extracted shared Connect HTTP+JSON client `src/core/conversation-service.ts` strictly restricted to loopback addresses (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`), with `redirect: "error"` blocking cross-origin 3xx SSRF & CSRF header leakage, control-character rejection, outbound `<private>`/secret redaction, zero `csrfToken` echo, and graceful offline degradation.
- **X-Ray Clean Fork via Service**: `app_xray_fork_via_service` (app-only, default read-only dry-run preview; `confirmCreate: true` creates a fresh conversation via `ConversationService/CreateConversation` with automatic fallback to `sendMessage`).
- **Radar Read-Only Reconciliation**: `app_radar_reconcile_conversations` (app-only, read-only) compares local Radar board sessions against live host `ListConversations` state to highlight drifted-to-idle and host-only running sessions.

### 3. Antigravity Marketplace Readiness
- Refined `plugin.json` to strictly 10 official allowed top-level keys with a concise **148-character** description, 3 actionable `suggestedPrompts`, transparent 128×128 `assets/logo.svg`, and zero always-on `rules/AGENTS.md`.
- Extended `agy-nov doctor` to check all **18 core assets** plus **4 Marketplace Readiness Checks**.

## Verification
- **Local Full Suite**: 100 suites / 280 tests passed; independent read-only red-team audit `PASS`.
- **3-OS Real CI Matrix**: [Run 46045837939](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/actions/runs/46045837939) — **6/6 passed** (`macos-latest`, `ubuntu-latest`, `windows-latest` × Node 20 / 22).
- **Canonical Tool Ceiling**: Strictly preserved at **47 model tools** (+0 bloat).
- **Bundles**: `dist/server.cjs` (1,583.5 KB) · `dist/hook.cjs` (211.9 KB) · `dist/cli.cjs` (190.0 KB) · `dist/ui/app.html` (1,390.2 KB).
